title_vi: Bức chân dung của Dorian Gray
translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Wilde’s epigrams, Lord Henry’s paradoxes and the lush aesthetic description are kept in polished, witty Vietnamese with the same inversion structure, and the final scene stays cold and precise.
decisions.rationale: The comedy and the horror need the same prose.

decisions.decision: The English text comes from Project Gutenberg #174 (the 1891 book version); em dashes and the French verse are preserved.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: ‘Far the best ending’ (by far the best) was inverted into ‘far from the best’; corrected.
James’s line to Sibyl was addressed to the wrong person (‘Con nghĩ Sibyl…’); now ‘Anh nghĩ em…’.
The clause ‘she had marred him for a moment, if he had wounded her for an age’ was left dangling by a bare ‘nếu’; corrected.
The long dawn sentence of chapter XI was calqued into near-unreadable Vietnamese; rewritten.
Frankincense and aloes were both ‘trầm hương’; now ‘nhũ hương’ and ‘trầm hương’.
Three relative clauses in the Renaissance catalogue were syntactically broken; rewritten.
Gautier’s French verse was flat prose; now twelve lines of Vietnamese verse with a regular rhythm and rhymes.
Lady Narborough’s jokes were carried over literally with a gloss; now Vietnamese idioms and a pun that keep the joke.
Every em dash of the English in the last four chapters was dropped; all were restored.
The women who braved censure for Dorian’s sake were turned into Dorian defying censure; corrected after the last blind review, by hand.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: The elder cynic and the young man; never ‘anh’.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #174, an electronic transcription of The Picture of Dorian Gray, the 1891 book version with the Preface and twenty chapters; the Gutenberg page does not name the exact printing and the text was not collated with the 1891 first book edition.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Two lines of the Gautier verse have seven syllables where the French has eight, and a few rhyme words are fillers.
The bonnet in Lady Narborough’s first clause no longer has a referent after the idiom swap.
Narration calls Alan Campbell ‘ông’ in a few units where ‘anh ta’ is the rule.

title_review.target_title: Bức chân dung của Dorian Gray
title_review.rationale: The title is rendered as ‘Bức chân dung của Dorian Gray’ (the portrait of Dorian Gray); no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The Preface: ‘The artist is the creator of beautiful things.’
The last unit: the servants recognise the withered man by his rings.
